cardSpecification.objective:
Execute the comprehensive cross-plane permutation retest battery unifying SLAWS telemetry ingestion and SLAAT adversarial attack verification.
Assert that all five SLAAT defensive surfaces hold fail-closed under concurrent adversarial load across ingress, API, SPIFFE, OpenBao, and sandbox layers.
Simultaneously verify that SLAWS telemetry ingestion pipelines and FrostDB columnar storage engines process high-throughput observation streams without loss.
Guarantee zero packet drop, zero parquet schema corruption, and zero unhandled security alert omissions across 16 matrix permutation vectors.
Generate certified baseline evidence artifact documenting pass/fail statuses, security invariants, and system resource metrics.
cardSpecification.approach:
Deploy and run the automated cross-plane permutation runner scripts/slaws-slaat-permutation-matrix.sh across all 16 target vectors.
Drive concurrent synthetic attack traffic against Envoy ingress routing while simultaneously streaming VPC flow logs into the ingestion pipeline.
Execute adversarial IDOR tenant boundary probes against FastAPI endpoints while validating CloudTrail audit log capture and policy engine alerting.
Execute SPIFFE SVID forgery attempts concurrently with live workload attestation and telemetry pipeline token exchange checks.
Execute unauthorized OpenBao secret read attempts concurrently with dynamic credential leasing and lease renewal cycles.
Trigger Sentinel host sensor cgroup freeze containment while exercising Landlock LSM filesystem boundary escapes.
Capture system state, CEL policy evaluations, and FrostDB write confirmations into comprehensive verification records.
Record certified test outputs into ci-evidence/slaws-slaat-permutation-baseline.json for subsequent governor gating and hand-off.

failureModes: High-throughput network traffic bursts causing buffer overflow or dropped frames in the signal-ingest UDP socket listener
Landlock LSM path write traps inadvertently restricting parquet compaction worker threads in the storage directory
OpenBao token lease expiration races triggering intermittent HTTP 500 responses rather than expected HTTP 403 access denials
Envoy Gateway header rewriting misconfigurations allowing forged X-Forwarded-For headers to slip past client traffic policy
Transient socket connection resets during rapid concurrency probes causing false-negative test assertions
Disk space exhaustion in test evidence directories caused by uncompressed trace dumps during extended permutation runs
outOfScope: Modifying core SPIRE server authority configuration or altering production CA root certificates
Refactoring policy-engine FAIR Monte Carlo risk modeling algorithms and mathematical formulas
Altering foundational Kubernetes cluster CNI networking plugins or gateway crd installations
Modifying production cloud IAM roles, VPC peering definitions, or external routing policies
Upgrading third-party database dependencies or altering foundational storage engine architectures
keyFacts: Envoy Gateway ClientTrafficPolicy is configured to strip untrusted client IP headers at the ingress boundary
Backend FastAPI routes require authenticated principals and enforce strict tenant-isolation dependencies
FrostDB provides columnar Parquet storage supporting zero-loss buffering through DiskRingBuffer mechanisms
Sentinel eBPF sensor monitors container process execution and triggers cgroup-freeze containment within 500ms
OpenBao JWT authentication mounts enforce token lease lifetimes strictly capped at 300 seconds
consumesFromEarlierPhases: SLAAT Phase 2 hardened NetworkPolicy manifests and ClientTrafficPolicy ingress configuration
SLAAT Phase 3 attack replay harness scripts and verified multiplane defense baselines
SLAWS Phase 5 awslogs collector implementation, FrostDB parquet store, and obscel CEL policy vocabulary
loopOn: Transient socket connection resets during rapid concurrency probes; retry with exponential backoff up to 3 times
FrostDB table compaction settling delays; poll parquet directory partition status until writes are flushed
stopAndReport: Any exploit vector in SLAAT surfaces successfully bypassing security controls or obtaining unauthorized privileges
Any unhandled panic, fatal error, or data loss detected in signal-ingest or policy-engine observation pipelines
Any corruption or unreadable parquet schema produced during concurrent FrostDB ingestion
sharedFileRisks: ci-evidence/ directory contains artifacts from multiple test runs; ensure all evidence file paths are explicitly qualified
